body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> The Consumer Electronics Association (CEA)® announced today that Boo-Keun Yoon, President of Samsung's Visual Display Business, will deliver a keynote address at the 2011 International CES®.
Owned and produced by CEA, the 2011 International CES, the world's largest consumer technology tradeshow, will be held in January 6-9, 2011, in Las Vegas, Nevada.

"We are thrilled to welcome back Samsung to its second CES keynote," said Gary Shapiro, president and CEO, CEA. "Samsung is a global leader in technology and has taken 3DTV to the next level of home entertainment. We look forward to hearing Boo-Keun Yoon's vision on the latest innovations that will change the shape of consumer technology."
Yoon will deliver his CES keynote address on opening day of the 2011 International CES at 4:30 p.m. Thursday, January 6 in the Las Vegas Hilton Center.

As President of Samsung's Visual Display Business and Chief Design Officer, Boo-Keun Yoon oversees all activities surrounding a broad portfolio of devices, including TVs, monitors, Blu-ray players and other connected consumer digital products.
Under his leadership, Samsung has maintained its No.1 status in terms of global market sharing for TVs, monitors and Blu-ray players.

In addition, he has successfully led several efforts to commercialize market-leading innovations such as Samsung's LED TV in 2009 and, most recently, the company's total 3D entertainment solution – a full product suite consisting of TVs, Blu-ray home theater systems and glasses that make it possible for consumers to enjoy 3D contently in the comfort of their homes. Announcing the world's first TV apps at the 2010 CES, Boo-Keun Yoon started another innovation in Smart TV and continues to open a new era of TV by transforming the viewing experiences of consumers.
Boo-Keun Yoon joins Microsoft's Steve Ballmer and Verizon's Ivan Seidenberg as 2011 CES keynote speakers. Additional keynotes for the 2011 CES will be announced in the coming months.

The 2011 International CES will feature 2,500 global technology companies unveiling the latest consumer technology products and services across 15 major product categories including the latest in audio, automotive electronics, connected home technologies, digital imaging, electronic gaming, entertainment/content, and more.
For more information on the 2011 International CES, visit CESweb.org.
